name: Shelf benthos
description: The invertebrate life of the open shelf seafloor: large crustaceans, molluscs, worms, small crustaceans, other invertebrates and meiobenthos. Functional group pooling the source's six shelf-benthic compartments - the detritus-driven benthic guild that underpins the demersal food web; pooled to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
